description: Requests access to host on Tempi (create event types, share a booking page). Not needed to book meetings, since booking pages are public. Returns the status: pending, approved (sign in to the Tempi web app), rejected, or open (no waitlist, sign in directly). Joining again with the same email returns the current status.
